verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَلِيفَازُ ٱلتَّيْمَانِيُّ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

verses.ar: «هَلْ يَنْفَعُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱللهَ؟ بَلْ يَنْفَعُ نَفْسَهُ ٱلْفَطِنُ!
verses.kjv: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
verses.web: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

verses.ar: هَلْ مِنْ مَسَرَّةٍ لِلْقَدِيرِ إِذَا تَبَرَّرْتَ، أَوْ مِنْ فَائِدَةٍ إِذَا قَوَّمْتَ طُرُقَكَ؟
verses.kjv: [Is it] any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or [is it] gain [to him], that thou makest thy ways perfect?
verses.web: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

verses.ar: هَلْ عَلَى تَقْوَاكَ يُوَبِّخُكَ، أَوْ يَدْخُلُ مَعَكَ فِي ٱلْمُحَاكَمَةِ؟
verses.kjv: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
verses.web: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ شَرُّكَ عَظِيمًا، وَآثَامُكَ لَا نِهَايَةَ لَهَا؟
verses.kjv: [Is] not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
verses.web: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ ٱرْتَهَنْتَ أَخَاكَ بِلَا سَبَبٍ، وَسَلَبْتَ ثِيَابَ ٱلْعُرَاةِ.
verses.kjv: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.web: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.ar: مَاءً لَمْ تَسْقِ ٱلْعَطْشَانَ، وَعَنِ ٱلْجَوْعَانِ مَنَعْتَ خُبْزًا.
verses.kjv: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.web: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

verses.ar: أَمَّا صَاحِبُ ٱلْقُوَّةِ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَرْضُ، وَٱلْمُتَرَفِّعُ ٱلْوَجْهِ سَاكِنٌ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: But [as for] the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
verses.web: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

verses.ar: ٱلْأَرَامِلَ أَرْسَلْتَ خَالِيَاتٍ، وَذِرَاعُ ٱلْيَتَامَى ٱنْسَحَقَتْ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.web: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.ar: لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ حَوَالَيْكَ فِخَاخٌ، وَيُرِيعُكَ رُعْبٌ بَغْتَةً
verses.kjv: Therefore snares [are] round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
verses.web: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

verses.ar: أَوْ ظُلْمَةٌ فَلَا تَرَى، وَفَيْضُ ٱلْمِيَاهِ يُغَطِّيكَ.
verses.kjv: Or darkness, [that] thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.web: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا ٱللهُ فِي عُلُوِّ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ. وَٱنْظُرْ رَأْسَ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ مَا أَعْلَاهُ!
verses.kjv: [Is] not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.web: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

verses.ar: فَقُلْتَ: كَيْفَ يَعْلَمُ ٱللهُ؟ هَلْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ ٱلضَّبَابِ يَقْضِي؟
verses.kjv: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
verses.web: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

verses.ar: ٱلسَّحَابُ سِتْرٌ لَهُ فَلَا يُرَى، وَعَلَى دَائِرَةِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ يَتَمَشَّى.
verses.kjv: Thick clouds [are] a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
verses.web: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

verses.ar: هَلْ تَحْفَظُ طَرِيقَ ٱلْقِدَمِ ٱلَّذِي دَاسَهُ رِجَالُ ٱلْإِثْمِ،
verses.kjv: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
verses.web: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ قُبِضَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَ ٱلْوَقْتِ؟ ٱلْغَمْرُ ٱنْصَبَّ عَلَى أَسَاسِهِمِ.
verses.kjv: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
verses.web: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

verses.ar: ٱلْقَائِلِينَ لِلهِ: ٱبْعُدْ عَنَّا. وَمَاذَا يَفْعَلُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ لَهُمْ؟
verses.kjv: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
verses.web: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

verses.ar: وَهُوَ قَدْ مَلَأَ بُيُوتَهُمْ خَيْرًا. لِتَبْعُدْ عَنِّي مَشُورَةُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ.
verses.kjv: Yet he filled their houses with good [things:] but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.web: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.ar: ٱلْأَبْرَارُ يَنْظُرُونَ وَيَفْرَحُونَ، وَٱلْبَرِيءُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ قَائِلِينَ:
verses.kjv: The righteous see [it], and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
verses.web: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يُبَدْ مُقَاوِمُونَا، وَبَقِيَّتُهُمْ قَدْ أَكَلَتْهَا ٱلنَّارُ؟
verses.kjv: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
verses.web: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

verses.ar: «تَعَرَّفْ بِهِ وَٱسْلَمْ. بِذَلِكَ يَأْتِيكَ خَيْرٌ.
verses.kjv: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
verses.web: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

verses.ar: ٱقْبَلِ ٱلشَّرِيعَةَ مِنْ فِيهِ، وَضَعْ كَلَامَهُ فِي قَلْبِكَ.
verses.kjv: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
verses.web: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

verses.ar: إِنْ رَجَعْتَ إِلَى ٱلْقَدِيرِ تُبْنَى. إِنْ أَبْعَدْتَ ظُلْمًا مِنْ خَيْمَتِكَ،
verses.kjv: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
verses.web: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

verses.ar: وَأَلْقَيْتَ ٱلتِّبْرَ عَلَى ٱلتُّرَابِ وَذَهَبَ أُوفِيرَ بَيْنَ حَصَا ٱلْأَوْدِيَةِ.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the [gold] of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
verses.web: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

verses.ar: يَكُونُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ تِبْرَكَ وَفِضَّةَ أَتْعَابٍ لَكَ،
verses.kjv: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
verses.web: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ حِينَئِذٍ تَتَلَذَّذُ بِٱلْقَدِيرِ وَتَرْفَعُ إِلَى ٱللهِ وَجْهَكَ.
verses.kjv: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.web: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

verses.ar: تُصَلِّي لَهُ فَيَسْتَمِعُ لَكَ، وَنُذُورُكَ تُوفِيهَا.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
verses.web: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

verses.ar: وَتَجْزِمُ أَمْرًا فَيُثَبَّتُ لَكَ، وَعَلَى طُرُقِكَ يُضِيءُ نُورٌ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.web: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

verses.ar: إِذَا وُضِعُوا تَقُولُ: رَفْعٌ. وَيُخَلِّصُ ٱلْمُنْخَفِضَ ٱلْعَيْنَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: When [men] are cast down, then thou shalt say, [There is] lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
verses.web: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

verses.ar: يُنَجِّي غَيْرَ ٱلْبَرِيءِ وَيُنْجَى بِطَهَارَةِ يَدَيْكَ».
verses.kjv: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
verses.web: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
